nodes.summary: For a real number $x$, $I_1(x)$ is the modified Bessel function of the first kind of order $1$ at $x$, that is, $I_1(x) = \sum_{k \ge 0} x^{2k+1} / (2^{2k+1} \, k! \, (k+1)!)$.
nodes.title: Modified Bessel function of the first kind of order one

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $m, k$ and a real number $x$, the $k$-th term of the series for the modified Bessel function of the first kind of order $m$ is $x^{2k+m} / (2^{2k+m} \, k! \, (k+m)!)$.
nodes.title: Terms of the modified Bessel series

nodes.summary: For a real number $x$, $I_0(x)$ is the modified Bessel function of the first kind of order $0$ at $x$, that is, $I_0(x) = \sum_{k \ge 0} x^{2k} / (2^{2k} \, (k!)^2)$.
nodes.title: Modified Bessel function of the first kind of order zero

nodes.summary: For a natural number $m$ and real $x$, the modified Bessel function of the first kind of order $m$ is $I_m(x) = \sum_{k \ge 0} x^{2k+m} / (2^{2k+m} \, k! \, (k+m)!)$.
nodes.title: Modified Bessel function of the first kind

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
